viewport_text:
j/k scroll | Esc back
Dashboard controls
Tab: cycle machines and All machines
j/k: select a row
Enter/i: inspect task or observed agent
a: attach exact pane; Ctrl-A d detaches
r: task result
c: cancel task coordination
s: stop managed task
l: reconcile retained task evidence
R: reload machine catalog
Esc: cancel preparation or close detail
q: close detail or quit dashboard
Actions require fresh evidence.
Task-only actions refuse observed
agents.
